translations.web: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
translations.bsb: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
